title: Interacting Large Language Model Agents. Bayesian Social Learning Based Interpretable Models.

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the tendency of interacting LLM agents to ignore private observations and conform to public belief (information cascades) during sequential Bayesian inference tasks. This is measured through simulated multi-agent environments performing tasks like hate speech peddler identification and product quality assessment, analyzing the threshold at which agents collapse to a single decision.
